purpose: Every Biupiu application and system family is measured against the same native DigiCat, DigiFile, Learning, semantic, module, adapter, functionality and performance contracts.
baseline_rule: Current build remains the immutable functional baseline/control until audit evidence is complete.

mandatory_layers.Learning: failure/observation/regression learning record and governed proposal flow
mandatory_layers.modules: module inventory, dependency graph, implementation and test state
mandatory_layers.adapters: adapter inventory, contract, provider/platform boundary and health state
mandatory_layers.benchmarks: same workload/functionality suite plus platform-specific performance metrics

rules: DigiCat indexes; it does not become execution authority.
DigiFile records evidence; it does not promote code.
Learning proposes and records; Core/DMS validates promotion.
Native functionality is preferred; federation/adapters are used when required by platform or protocol.
Every family must expose the same canonical capability vocabulary even when implementations differ by language/platform.
AS-IS and FULL-INTEGRATION trees are measured with the same functionality suite.
Performance optimization is evaluated only after functional equivalence is demonstrated.
Historical builds are archived by immutable commit/provenance and remain regression references.
PC/Windows/UE5 remain HOLD for this Android/native audit phase.

target_architecture.functionality_tree: preserve existing systems and maximise verified functionality
target_architecture.integrated_tree: federate/core-integrate proven functionality for performance experiments
target_architecture.archive_tree: immutable historical builds used as control/reference
